2-image.caption: An image entry: its size and dimensions on the row, the picture in the pane

3-colors.caption: The Colors filter: a copied colour is its own swatch on the row and in the pane

5-edit.caption: Edit (cmd+E): the text in a textarea; the submit copies it, so the edited text is the newest entry

6-qr.caption: Show as QR code (cmd+shift+K): the entry's text as a code to scan, large in a level
